title: Exact Algebraic Computation of Learning Coefficients for Two-Dimensional Singular Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.20183v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Classical information criteria such as the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) rely on regularity assumptions that break down for singular models, leading to incorrect model selection in settings such as deep learning. The Widely Applicable Bayesian Information Criterion (WBIC) relies on local learning coefficients $\lambda$, which in the analytic case coincides with local Real Log Canonical Thresholds (RLCT) of the Kullback-Leibler divergence of the model, to capture correct marginal likelihood asymptotics. Exact computation of the learning coefficients has been limited to special cases, and only sampling-based estimation methods are generally applicable. translated_title: 二维奇异模型学习系数的精确代数计算
translated_abstract: 经典信息准则如贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）依赖于正则性假设，这些假设在奇异模型中失效，导致在深度学习等场景下的模型选择不正确。广泛适用的贝叶斯信息准则（WBIC）依赖于局部学习系数$\lambda$，在解析情况下，该系数与模型的Kullback-Leibler散度的局部实对数规范阈值（RLCT）一致，以捕捉正确的边际似然渐近性。学习系数的精确计算仅限于特殊情况，通常只能使用基于采样的估计方法。我们提出了第一个确定性算法，能够精确计算任何二维模型的局部RLCT，其中模型的Kullback-Leibler距离与多项式接触等价，我们推导出其复杂性上界，并展示了其在广泛模型类别中的有效性，附有应用示例。
tldr: 本文提出了首个确定性算法，能精确计算二维奇异模型的局部RLCT，并给出了复杂度上界和广泛适用性证明。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first deterministic algorithm for exact computation of local RLCTs for two-dimensional singular models, with a complexity bound and broad applicability.
